query: West Nile virus California 2024 human cases deaths weekly report site:westnile.ca.gov OR site:cdph.ca.gov
query_rationale: The California West Nile Virus website (westnile.ca.gov) and CDPH (cdph.ca.gov) are the primary authoritative sources for weekly WNV human surveillance summaries in California. These pages publish cumulative and weekly case counts, deaths, neuroinvasive disease counts, and county breakdowns. Targeting these domains directly maximizes the chance of retrieving the August 2024 weekly reports.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDPH or westnile.ca.gov weekly WNV surveillance summary page with tabular case counts by county and week
expected_trust_signal: Official California state public health agency domain (.ca.gov); data attributed to CDPH Infectious Disease Branch or Vector-Borne Disease Section

query: West Nile virus California August 2024 human cases neuroinvasive deaths county surveillance
query_rationale: A broader web search using natural language terms likely to appear in CDPH press releases, county health department reports, and official surveillance summaries. 'Neuroinvasive' is the standard CDC/CDPH classification term for severe WNV disease and will help surface case-classification data. Avoids over-quoted exact phrases that may not match real page text.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDPH press release, county health department advisory, or westnile.ca.gov summary referencing August 2024 case counts
expected_trust_signal: Source attributed to CDPH, a California county public health department, or official state surveillance program

query: CDC ArboNET West Nile virus 2024 California cases deaths statistics
query_rationale: CDC ArboNET is the national arboviral surveillance system that aggregates state-reported WNV data including California. It publishes annual and weekly case statistics by state, including confirmed/probable cases, neuroinvasive disease, and deaths. This provides a cross-validation source independent of CDPH and may include August 2024 cumulative figures.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC ArboNET weekly or annual WNV statistics table for 2024 with California state row
expected_trust_signal: CDC.gov domain; data labeled as ArboNET surveillance system output

query: "West Nile virus" California 2024 cases deaths August outbreak health department
query_rationale: News articles published in August 2024 frequently cite official CDPH or county health department figures and can surface specific case counts, deaths, and locality data that corroborate or supplement official reports. This query uses natural language terms without over-quoted phrases to maximize recall across news outlets covering the California WNV season peak.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: News article from California regional or statewide outlet (e.g., LA Times, Sacramento Bee, SF Chronicle) citing CDPH or county health figures for August 2024 WNV cases
expected_trust_signal: Article cites CDPH, county health officer, or westnile.ca.gov as data source; published between 2024-08-01 and 2024-09-15

query: westnile.ca.gov arbobulletin 2024 weekly download August site:westnile.ca.gov
query_rationale: The westnile.ca.gov Arbobulletin download page lists all weekly PDF surveillance bulletins by week number. Targeting this index page will enumerate the specific download IDs and week numbers for August 2024 bulletins (approximately weeks 31–35), allowing identification of all relevant PDFs beyond the two already found (weeks 29 and 32). This is the highest-priority gap: without the full set of August weekly bulletins, cumulative case counts cannot be anchored to the August 2024 window.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: westnile.ca.gov Arbobulletin index page listing weekly PDF reports with week numbers and download links for 2024
expected_trust_signal: Official westnile.ca.gov domain; CDPH Arboviral Surveillance Program weekly bulletin series
previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q1 — Arbobulletin PDFs for weeks 29 and 32 were found; need to enumerate all August 2024 weeks (31–35)

query: California West Nile virus arbobulletin week 33 34 35 2024 human cases deaths
query_rationale: Epidemiological weeks 33–35 of 2024 correspond to August 11 – September 7, covering the latter two-thirds of August 2024. These bulletins will contain the cumulative case counts and deaths as of late August 2024, which are essential for deriving August-specific totals. Directly querying for these week numbers targets the specific PDFs most likely to contain the peak August 2024 surveillance data.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: westnile.ca.gov Arbobulletin PDF for week 33, 34, or 35 of 2024 with cumulative human case counts, deaths, and county breakdown
expected_trust_signal: westnile.ca.gov domain; CDPH weekly arboviral surveillance bulletin with week number and year in filename or title
previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q1/q2 — weeks 29 and 32 found; weeks 33–35 needed to cover full August 2024 window

query: CDC West Nile virus 2024 current season statistics cases deaths by state California
query_rationale: The CDC publishes a '2024 West Nile Virus Activity in the United States' current-season statistics page (distinct from the historic data page already found) that includes weekly updated case counts by state, including California, with neuroinvasive and non-neuroinvasive breakdowns and deaths. This provides independent cross-validation of CDPH figures and may include August 2024 cumulative totals for California. The historic data page (cdc.gov/west-nile-virus/data-maps/historic-data.html) was found in iteration 1 but covers 1999–2025 aggregates; the current-season page provides finer temporal resolution.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC.gov 2024 WNV current-season statistics table or map with California state row showing confirmed/probable cases, neuroinvasive disease counts, and deaths as of August or September 2024
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain; page title references '2024' and 'current season' or 'preliminary data'; data attributed to ArboNET
previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q3 — CDC historic data page found but does not provide 2024 current-season weekly resolution; current-season page needed

query: California West Nile virus death August 2024 CDPH hospitalization confirmed cases county
query_rationale: The Placer County press release (54 cases, 5 deaths) and CIDRAP Facebook post (5th California WNV death) from iteration 1 suggest multiple California WNV deaths occurred during or around August 2024, but exact dates and hospitalization counts are unconfirmed. News articles published in August–September 2024 citing CDPH or county health officials are the most likely source for death-specific dates, hospitalization figures, and county-level attribution. This query targets those articles directly, with 'hospitalization' added to surface the one target field most absent from iteration 1 results.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: California regional or statewide news article (e.g., Sacramento Bee, LA Times, KCRA, ABC7) published August–September 2024 citing CDPH or county health official figures for WNV deaths and hospitalizations in California
expected_trust_signal: Article published between 2024-08-01 and 2024-09-30; cites CDPH, county health officer, or westnile.ca.gov as data source; includes specific death count and/or hospitalization figure for California
previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q4 — deaths hinted at (5 deaths, Placer County) but no hospitalization data found; death dates unconfirmed for August 2024 window
